title: Hollerith census punch card
alt: Historical punched card with printed category fields and rectangular holes encoding census information.
caption: A Hollerith punched card, around 1895: human traits translated into machine-readable fields.
teachingUse: Makes the movement from social category to machine-readable record visible before contemporary computing.
